facts.text_en: Candelaria produced 125,182 tonnes of fine copper in 2025 and 142,066 tonnes in 2024; its first year with reported production is 1994 (Cochilco, Chilean copper mine production by company).
facts.text_es: Candelaria produjo 125.182 toneladas de cobre fino en 2025 y 142.066 toneladas en 2024; su primer ano con produccion reportada es 1994 (Cochilco, produccion chilena de cobre de mina por empresa).
